Observed on 2026-09-19 against the final uncommitted qualification tree based on
`700b71ddf0f33a846d67c7db138f01f09c1d6bdd`. This section supersedes earlier
active/unfinished checkpoint statements; their historical observations retain
only their original image scope. The operator authorized final verification and
closure after the stress checkpoint, and requested one whole-change human commit
rather than an agent commit that would include inherited edits. No claim that
these follow-up changes are already committed or merged is made.

Fresh `just private_memory_check` and `just private_memory_isolation_check`
passed on both pinned QEMU 11.0.1 profiles, one CPU, ARM 2048 MiB and RV64
3072 MiB. Each capacity run observed four simultaneous 65536-page holders
(262144 pages total), initial zeroing, complete distinct-pattern verification,
and 128 large data frames per holder. Three holders remained resident while D
completed twenty actual fault/reclaim/restart/replacement sequences, including
admissions 17 through 20. All replacements were zero-filled; all four final
holders exited. Equivalent reclamation censuses did not drift, and final
usable backing, mappings, quota and allocator ownership reconciled to baseline
with retained anchors explicitly occupied and reused. Holder A's unchanged
shared-buffer budget remained usable at full private residency.

Both isolation runs observed actual owned buffers and reciprocal B-to-C/C-to-B
loans, positive outside-window mappings, backed/reserved private-window refusals,
unowned-handle and sealed-write refusals, explicit unmap/return/release, intact
private sentinels and zero terminal loan/export/ticket/quota state. Read, Write
and NX Execute faults were joined to exact task identities and addresses.

The four stress runs passed earlier in this same task on the unchanged final
runtime sources; subsequent changes were documentation and system-spec negative
controls only. They directly exercised mixed 4 KiB/2 MiB growth, three measured
physical backing discontinuities, reclaimed extent reuse, partial allocation
and mapping failures, construction unwind, near-limit allocator reservations,
and successful retries while three full peers retained data. Heap stress
verified 251723776 payload bytes plus overhead, hole reuse, exhaustion and
whole-payload reuse within a 256 MiB quota. Pressure reserves actual allocator
entries; it does not populate a kernel CNode with capabilities. Equivalent
subject retirement and final conservation were checked on both targets.

Final boundary coverage includes runtime holder +1 refusal, root host admission
of the exact aggregate and refusal of aggregate +1, component-spec maximum +1,
and system-spec exact-boundary positives plus six holder/aggregate +1 negatives
for ARM, RV64 and conservative RPi5. Over-declared generation rejection is host
admission evidence, not a claimed malformed-generation QEMU boot. The two
budget/lifecycle v1 formats retain their layouts, field semantics and identity
domains while increasing allowed values; older roots must reject enlarged
values. Smaller declarations remain compatible, as verified by the ceiling,
cycles and three-restart regression workloads. Non-QEMU targets retain 512/2048
page defaults, and shared-buffer authority/budgets were not widened.

Passed during this task: `just private_memory_stress_check`,
`just private_memory_check`, `just private_memory_isolation_check`,
`just private_memory_cycles_check`, `just lifecycle_restart_check`,
`just sel4_root_boot_check`, `just sel4_reclamation_check`,
`just sel4_loan_check`, `just sel4_sample_check`, `just io_block_check`,
`just test_sel4_root` (265/265), `just test_host`, `just fmt_check_all`,
`just lint_all`, `just ruff`, `just contracts_check`, `just generation_check`,
`just component_spec_check`, `just system_spec_check` (33 named refusals),
`just system_image_builder_check`, `just system_composition_closure_check`,
`just component_crate_split_check`, `just machete`, `just docs_check`,
`just tasks_check`, `just typos`, and `just sel4_gate_control_check`
(45 gates, 2144 rejected mutations, eight identity and four runtime cases).
The final independent exit audit found no remaining blocker or major finding
after system-spec boundary controls and capability-matrix documentation were
added and independently reviewed.

Raw serial files are local diagnostic artifacts at
`build/private-memory-{1g,isolation}-qemu-{arm,riscv}-virt.log` and the four
`build/sel4-private-memory-*stress*.log` paths listed in the stress checkpoint.
Hashes above bind observed bytes, not remote or immutable archival retention.
The operator explicitly replaced the old archive/devlog requirement with the
current canonical evidence policy. Qualification is QEMU-only: no physical
machine, adaptive capacity, compaction, live shrink, or larger envelope is
claimed. The parent epic is not automatically closed by this item.
